I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is tokio, chosen for its fit with the broader ecosystem.

The decision comes from the project's recorded memory, not from the repo. The repo has no mention of tokio or async-std. Memory holds two decisions on this. The earlier one (12:42p) standardized on async-std. The later one (12:43p) explicitly reverses it and switches to tokio, so I used tokio and left the retired async-std choice out of the file.

The first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. Nothing is committed.
